rv.q: It’s unadulterated joy: a huge, healing hug of a show, generous and utterly beguiling.
For all the ravishing imagery and the collective endeavour involved, this show isn't quirky or adult-friendly enough for that.

My Neighbour Totoro is a hugely successful show based on a Japanese movie made in 1988. The setting is a haunted house occupied by two little girls who encounter various creatures rendered on stage by puppets. The story has no action, danger or jeopardy so it’s likely to bore small boys and their dads.
Beautiful design, musical loveliness and warm tone
The Royal Shakespeare Company's My Neighbour Totoro is actual magic
Genuinely enticing production that is great for all audiences

ru.inst: Released via show website. Cheaper than TodayTix and available for longer.
